The first public build of Relay: a remote control for whatever video is
playing on another screen — an Android phone or a browser tab.

- **Six independent ways to connect** — local Wi-Fi, WebRTC peer-to-peer, relay
  over WebSocket, relay over plain HTTP, MQTT and Bluetooth — all kept open at
  once, in the order you choose, with instant failover.
- **New remote app** (Expo): jump by any amount (presets, or type `45`, `2m`,
  `1:30`, `1h`; hold to repeat), scrub bar, play/pause, a fullscreen key that
  shows which way it will go, several paired devices, diagnostics, QR pairing.
- **Fullscreen that works in Chrome and Brave** on Android: the receiver now
  finds and presses the web player's own button, and knows when to leave.
- **Browser extension** for desktop Chrome and Brave: control any tab's video.
- **Shizuku support** (optional) for fullscreen keys and taps when
  accessibility is not available.

New here? Start with the [README](https://github.com/sandoramix/slop-remote-relay#getting-started).
